HARM CHECK: verified, not inferred. Line 22 reads 'so what you built in Module 1<!--flag:module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop--> and Module 4<!--/flag:module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop--> comes with you.' `flag:module:X` renders its span only when X is in the delivered cut (site/layouts/curriculum.js line ~507). `spot-gaps-build-the-loop` = M6. Checked the northwind cut (site/layouts/curriculum.js 'agentic-engineering-101-northwind': modules = getting-going/plan-mode-done-right/run-the-first-experiment/learn-from-the-test — M1, M2, M4, M5; no M3, no M6) — this exercise ships there (learn-from-the-test.md line 50 includes it). With M6 absent, the 'and Module 4' span is stripped even though Module 4 (run-the-first-experiment) DOES run in that cut and its gitignored artefacts are exactly what this bullet describes riding into the fork. Confirmed live in the already-built customer output: `site/clients/acme/agentic-engineering-101-northwind/index.html:4328` renders '...so what you built in Module 1 comes with you.' — Module 4 unmentioned. Cross-checked against the pin (441b361f): the span there read 'Module 1<!--flag:module:earn-the-trust--> and Module 3<!--/flag:module:earn-the-trust-->' — gating a genuinely-conditional module (M3/earn-the-trust, which northwind also drops) is the pattern used correctly elsewhere in this same M5 module (learn-from-the-test.md uses flag:module:X / flag:no-module:X to gate content specific to X, e.g. 'Bring to Module 6' only when M6 runs). Module 4 is not conditional anywhere this exercise ships (M5 without a prior M4 send-off doesn't exist), so gating it on M6's presence is the wrong flag regardless of variant. The line-59 maintainer note ('runtime-fork flags intact: module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop gates both the "and Module 4" clause and the Module 6 merge-back sentence') asserts the mechanism is preserved, but the diff (441b361f..HEAD) shows the flag target itself changed from module:earn-the-trust to module:spot-gaps-build-the-loop in the same edit that renamed Module 3 to Module 4 — the note describes the post-edit state as intact, it does not establish that consolidating two previously-distinct conditional spans onto one flag was a reviewed content decision, and nothing in it explains why Module 4's mention should depend on M6. Not defeated by the accept-note: the note attests to the phase-1 extraction being faithful (2026-08-25), not to this flag/module pairing being cross-variant-correct — a claim the built northwind output falsifies directly.
